description: This PHP source file defines the LDAPTestService class, which extends LDAPService to test LDAP connection and authentication, including methods for setting up an LDAP adapter, testing connection, and handling exceptions.

classes.name: LDAPTestService
classes.description: A service class for testing LDAP connections and authentication, extending LDAPService and using LDAPLoggerTrait.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes LDAPTestService with an optional LDAPSetting object.

methods.name: getAdapter
methods.description: Creates and returns an LDAP adapter configured with the current LDAP settings.

methods.name: testConnection
methods.description: Attempts to bind to LDAP using provided credentials to test connectivity.

methods.name: testAuthentication
methods.description: Performs a test connection and returns a status message indicating success or failure, logging errors as needed.
